question_review_correction.description: Validated or corrected version of a bias-detection question, with reasoning first for easy inspection and learning.

reasoning.description: Explanation of whether and why the original question was modified. Leave empty if no changes were needed.

original_question.description: The original input question that was evaluated.

corrected_question.description: The improved question (if revised). If not revised, must be identical to the original.

was_modified.description: Indicates whether the original question was modified (true) or kept as-is (false).
